description.en: Animated React and Tailwind UI components and blocks compatible with shadcn/ui.
description.zh: 兼容 shadcn/ui 的 React 与 Tailwind 动效组件库，提供开箱即用的 SaaS 区块、微交互与落地页模板。

content.en: Forge UI is a curated React and Tailwind CSS UI library featuring animated components, marketing blocks, illustrations, and full landing page templates. Fully compatible with the shadcn/ui ecosystem, it provides copy-paste ready code powered by Motion and GSAP, spanning auth clusters, AI interface widgets (LLM Nexus, Integration Orbit), fluid canvas backgrounds, and smooth text typography effects.
content.zh: Forge UI 是一套基于 React 与 Tailwind CSS 的高质感动效组件库，深度兼容 shadcn/ui 生态。全库涵盖精美的 SaaS 营销区块、插画控件以及完整的落地页模版，底层依托 Motion 与 GSAP 驱动，提供包括智能认证卡片、AI 交互面板（LLM Nexus、轨道拓扑）、流动 Canvas 背景与文字微动效等即拷即用模块，帮助开发者快速交付视觉精致的现代 Web 应用。
